mechanism.family: Pet sale site: non-refundable 50% deposit to a personal Zelle account and cash-before-departure delivery fee, cancellation only as store credit at a dog kennel brand ('Chow Chow House')
mechanism.summary: Original page: Sphynx kitten listings with $400-$500 fees, 50% non-refundable deposit, hand-delivery fee paid in cash before departure, store-credit-only cancellation at 'Hairless cats home Chow Chow House', a Chow Chow mission statement in the footer, gmail contact. Research-added (authored): deposit form, confirm step naming a personal Zelle payee and $200 amount, Payment and Return Policy page, receipt.
mechanism.source_basis: FTC / BBB / Scamwatch pet-sale scam advisories: pay-first deposits by Zelle or Cash App to individuals, delivery fees demanded in cash or by courier, no refunds, seller identity inconsistencies.

You will be contacted by (one of the Kennel owners) shortly after to schedule a pickup or hand-delivery date. Danny is available in the Cattery Wednesday through Sunday, so if your kitten deposit was submitted on a Monday or Tuesday, you will be contacted when she returns on Wednesday.

Delivery: If your kitten requires our safe and sound hand-delivery service, delivery fees range from $200 – $600 within the United States and Canada, and $600 – $2,000 internationally. This fee does not include the cost of necessary travel expenses (such as round-trip airfare or the required international health certificate for kittens that are being imported into another country), which you will also be responsible for. The hand-delivery fee must be paid in cash before departure. All other fees may be paid in advance.
The remaining balance is due on the date of pickup or delivery.

If for any reason you would like to cancel your kitten reservation, you will be issued a store credit for the full amount of your deposit.
